item.title: DISTRICT 2 BASKETBALL: Tournaments tip off Tuesday
item.description: Local high school basketball teams begin their quest for championships and possibly more when the District 2 tournaments tip off Tuesday with a 16-game slate of contests in Class 5A and Class 4A boys, and Class 2A, Class 3A and Class 6A girls. item.title: ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Jaden Baltrusaitis, Tunkhannock swimming
item.description: Tunkhannock senior swimmer Jaden Baltrusaitis had a record-breaking day at the 2026 Les Richards Championships on Saturday, setting three meet records and winning four events. His time of 46.86 in the 100 free broke a pool and meet record that was set in 2009. He also set two pool and meet records in the 200 free relay and 400 free relay with his Tiger teammates.
